title: Paid ads gets decision logic: it stops showing "no engine" and proposes budget moves as cards the Owner answers
description: Flow health check (2026-11-11): Paid ads is on but held by no_engine. The flow is defined and GA4 pulls fine, but ENGINES has no entry for it, so the Supervisor holds every fire. This row adds the engine: its caps are the stream's budget and its cycle is plain code with no model call and no spend. A run reads the imports and the existing nextMove. over_target and on_target open one choose decision card titled for Paid ads whose ask names the cost per subscription and the target in dollars, with 2 to 4 options (one keeps the campaign as it is), a recommended option and a one-line reason. While a paid ads card is open, the same figures open no second one. waiting_for_data, learning and check_tracking open no budget card. The run report says proposed or quiet. The flow still never touches the campaign: no ad account credential, and read_research stays its only action class. Wave 3 of the master plan v2.
acceptance: With paid-ads on, its FlowView gate is not no_engine and its budget is the stream cap
A run with no report is quiet and opens no card
Twenty days over target open one choose card naming $150.00 and the target, with a keep option and a recommendation; a second run opens no second card
